# langsmith_managed_tool_server (Resource)

Registers a workspace-scoped MCP server with LangSmith Managed Tools. Requires a user-owned API key with the appropriate workspace permissions; service-account and service keys cannot create or delete servers. Supports public, OAuth, and secret (API key header) servers without storing upstream credentials; store secret values with `langsmith_managed_tool_profile_credential`. All configurable attributes require replacement; the API does not support changing workspace server enablement. OAuth scopes belong to the OAuth connection, not the server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "langsmith_managed_tool_server" "public" {
  name         = "public-mcp"
  upstream_url = "https://mcp.example.com/mcp"
}

resource "langsmith_managed_tool_server" "oauth" {
  name                       = "oauth-mcp"
  upstream_url               = "https://oauth-mcp.example.com/mcp"
  connection_type            = "oauth"
  agent_auth_connection_slug = "existing-oauth-connection"
  workspace_id               = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
}

output "managed_mcp_url" {
  value = langsmith_managed_tool_server.oauth.url
}

output "oauth_setup" {
  value = langsmith_managed_tool_server.oauth.oauth_setup
}

resource "langsmith_managed_tool_server" "api_key" {
  name            = "api-key-mcp"
  upstream_url    = "https://api-key-mcp.example.com/mcp"
  connection_type = "secret"
  secret_headers  = ["Authorization"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Server name, unique in the workspace ignoring case. Letters and digits, separated by single hyphens or underscores; LangSmith rewrites other names, which Terraform would then replace on every apply. Kit tool names are prefixed with this name.
- `upstream_url` (String) HTTPS Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint. LangSmith validates the upstream server; Terraform never contacts it directly.

### Optional

- `agent_auth_connection_slug` (String) Existing Agent Auth OAuth connection slug. Only valid with `connection_type = "oauth"`. Omit for automatic OAuth discovery and dynamic client registration where supported.
- `connection_type` (String) Upstream authentication: `none` (default), `oauth`, or `secret` (caller-supplied headers declared in `secret_headers`).
- `secret_headers` (Set of String) Upstream HTTP header names each caller supplies, such as `Authorization`. Required with `connection_type = "secret"` and invalid otherwise. Credential values include any prefix, such as `Bearer `.
- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace that owns this server. Defaults to the provider workspace. Use `workspace_id/server_id` when importing into a workspace other than the provider default.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the server is enabled. Workspace servers are always enabled; the API cannot change this setting.
- `id` (String) Registered server ID.
- `oauth_setup` (Attributes) Non-secret OAuth registration metadata, when returned by LangSmith. Null for public servers and connections without setup metadata. Register an OAuth app manually using the callback URL if dynamic client registration is unavailable. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--oauth_setup))
- `url` (String) Managed Tools MCP endpoint returned by LangSmith; may be a relative path.

<a id="nestedatt--oauth_setup"></a>
### Nested Schema for `oauth_setup`

Read-Only:

- `authorization_url` (String) OAuth authorization endpoint.
- `callback_url` (String) Redirect URI to register with the upstream OAuth provider.
- `oauth_provider_id` (String) Registered workspace OAuth app ID, when present.
- `pkce` (Boolean) Whether PKCE is enabled.
- `provider_slug` (String) Discovered OAuth provider slug.
- `revocation_url` (String) Optional OAuth revocation endpoint.
- `scopes` (Set of String) Discovered OAuth scopes.
- `token_endpoint_auth_method` (String) OAuth client authentication method.
- `token_url` (String) OAuth token endpoint, not a token.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import langsmith_managed_tool_server.public '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002'
terraform import langsmith_managed_tool_server.oauth '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003'
```
